description: Fork of exp321 (separate qk+v, current LUT-LM SOTA 1.5933 @ 8K) using joint qkv LUT at NAP=6, tph=1024. Continuation of the tph-sweep (exp322: t=256 +0.022 @3400; exp324: t=512 +0.012 @3400). Per-layer qkv params: 6144*64*160 = 62.9M (same as exp323's NAP=8, tph=256). 6 layers 377M; total ~828M. Wide-not-deep counterpart to exp323 at fixed total param budget — exact A/B testing whether NAP=8 (deep) or tph=1024 (wide) is better when given the same params for the joint qkv table. Hypothesis: residual_lut's wide-beats-deep rule (see project_residual_lut_prefers_more_tables) might extend to joint qkv when tables encode similar feature combinations across q/k/v.
